user.title: Add gaming PC
user.description: Select a gaming PC that currently advertises itself over MQTT. HA MQTT discovery does not need to be enabled.

abort.no_devices_found: No new gaming PC found. Make sure the Windows agent is running and publishing to SmartHouse/Gaming/+/discovery, then try again.

limits.title: Restrictions and schedule
limits.description: Set time limits using the sliders on the device page. Reset options disable the selected limit (weekend reset uses the weekday limit). Start/end: HH:MM, equal means all day.

update_settings.title: Windows update settings
update_settings.description: Set a trusted HTTPS URL to an approved version catalog, or leave blank to disable remote update controls.

mqtt_settings.title: MQTT configuration
mqtt_settings.description:
This is the shared Home Assistant MQTT broker connection, used by every integration and every enrolled PC. Status: {connection}. {connection_help}

Broker: {broker_host}, port {broker_port}, TLS: {broker_tls}. User name, password and certificates are never shown.

To change the broker, open Settings → Devices & services → MQTT and use Configure or Reconfigure there. This changes shared infrastructure that other integrations use too.

This PC: {device_id}. Mode: {mode}. Topic root: {root}. Discovery: {root}/discovery.

The Windows agent connects separately, using its own protected config.yaml on the PC. Changing the Home Assistant broker does not change the other connection, and the reverse. Update both when the broker moves.
